about_the_game:
GAMEPLAY

  • If hallucinations appear but do not persist, you are safe. Open the door to receive medicine from the visitor.

  • If the hallucinations do not disappear and won't fade, take the pill by the door to escape the dangerous hallucinations immediately.

  • If you follow this properly for 8 days, your condition may improve.

ABOUT THIS GAME

I have psychosis.

I don’t remember when the illness began, nor when the headaches first took hold.

Hallucinations, I'm used to them. But when those hallucinations stop fading away, taking over what's real, it’s a different story.

I must take my pill.

Caught between reality and illusion, are you ready to face what's on the other side?

PROGRESSIVE ENDINGS

This story unfolds across multiple playthroughs.

Find doll pieces hidden in the environment. Each piece brings you closer to the truth.

There are three main endings. 

Collect them all to unlock the true final ending.

Who's at the Door? is a short horror game (about 60 minutes) inspired by psychological walking sims like 'The Exit 8'. It allows you to experience the hallucinatory phenomena of the protagonist with psychosis.

CONTENT WARNING

This game includes themes or visuals not appropriate for all ages or workplace environments : Violence, general mature content-Depictions of blood, mental instability, eerie imagery, and sound effects-

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 from around 2016 or later
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 Feature Level AMD or NVIDIA Card with 1 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD Ryzen 7 from around 2018 or later
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 Feature Level AMD or NVIDIA Card with 4 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: You are trapped in a small house with psychosis, having lost your memory. Carefully observe your surroundings, distinguish between reality and hallucinations, and take the medication provided by visitors on time to overcome your illness.
supported_languages:
English*, Korean*, French, Spanish - Spain, Indonesian, Japanese, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support
